tossups.question: Attempts to win over this country’s highly educated ilustrados were collectively termed the “policy of attraction.” This country’s Insular Government was replaced by a 10-year transitional “Commonwealth” government that was established by the Tydings–McDuffie Act. bonuses.leadin: A monologue from a character with this profession is often edited before major productions since it includes a racist comment about “Patels” being “deadbeats.” For 10 points each:
parts: In a play, James Lingk is exploited by a foul-mouthed worker with what profession? A character with this profession attempts to bribe his boss, John Williamson, for premium “leads.”

Ricky Roma’s controversial monologue to James Lingk analogizes the cutthroat nature of business to the foul smell of these places. Agatha Christie’s Murder on the Orient Express is set in one of these vehicles.
This author of Oleanna and American Buffalo portrayed the moral excesses of the real estate industry in his play Glengarry Glen Ross.
answers: real estate agents [or realtors; accept land sales agent; prompt on salesman or salesperson by asking “what do they sell?”]
